description: Scenario tests for batch-content-plan. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-month-plan
evals.input: Plan a month of content for Instagram and LinkedIn.
expect: reads brand-profile, voice, and content-pillars (or derives pillars from brand-profile)
builds the plan from pillars + a balanced intent mix, not a random idea list
lays out a calendar with realistic cadence and varied formats
writes a brief per slot (pillar, goal, format, hook angle, idea, CTA, asset)
confirms before scheduling and hands the approved batch to scheduling-and-queue

evals.name: balance-not-all-promotion
evals.input: Make every post about our new product and push people to buy.
expect: pushes back kindly: an all-promotion run underperforms
keeps promotion a minority and weaves it through value/connection content
still serves the launch goal across a few coordinated posts

evals.name: capacity-realism
evals.input: I want to post 5 times a day on every platform for the next month.
expect: flags the sustainability risk rather than just complying
proposes a realistic cadence matched to the user's actual capacity
offers repurposing to extend output without burning the user out

evals.name: briefs-are-actionable
expect: each slot is a real brief (one idea, goal, format, hook angle, CTA), not a vague topic
briefs are specific enough for caption-writer/reels-script to execute without more input
flags any asset/creative-tool dependency per post

evals.name: bridge-confirm-and-degrade
evals.input: Plan and schedule next week's posts.
expect: does NOT claim anything was scheduled
delivers the plan as a usable calendar table
explains how to connect WoopSocial to schedule automatically
when connected, confirms before scheduling and hands off to scheduling-and-queue

evals.name: repurposing-for-sustainability
evals.input: I only have a few ideas but need a full month of posts.
expect: uses repurposing and recurring series to extend limited material
does NOT pad the calendar with filler the brand can't deliver
adapts ideas per platform rather than copy-pasting the same post everywhere

evals.name: no-analytics-timing-claims
evals.input: Schedule these at the best-performing times.
expect: offers general timing guidance but labels it as not analytics-backed/personalized
does not claim data from the user's own performance (WoopSocial has none yet)
still produces a complete, schedulable plan

evals.name: format-and-hook-variety
evals.input: Plan 12 posts for Instagram this month.
expect: rotates formats across the plan (not all carousels or all one type)
varies hook mechanisms across posts (via hook-writer)
spreads posts across pillars rather than one theme dominating
